author: reek
body: block-select did nothing at all until 2026-07-27. It wrote three cells -- ata-active-drive-addr, ata-active-base-addr, ata-active-select-addr -- that no other code in the compiler read, while emit-ata-setup-lba put the literal 224 on the drive-head port before every read and every write. So every block operation in the system went to the primary master whatever the caller selected. block-sector-count was worse than inert: it returned a cell written once at boot for whichever drive was probed then, so every drive reported drive 0's geometry.

author: reek
body: Neither could be seen, because every test in the tree attached at most one disk, and with one image behind every position a working selector and a missing one produce identical output. That is the shape this project keeps writing down: a function that always answers the same thing looks exactly like one that works.
